title: Long Term and Permanent Contraceptive
brief_summary: We will study with the different variables that affect the intention to use long- acting and permanent contraceptive methods among married women in Jordan through a cross sectional study. Self- administered questionnaire will be distributed to aid in data collection.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* females used or currently using long-term contraception

Exclusion Criteria:

* never users of contraception
